config.lua_scripts:
function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
  local cert_subject = request_handle:streamInfo():downstreamSslConnection():subjectPeerCertificate()
  if cert_subject then
    local cn = string.match(cert_subject, "CN=([^,]+)")
    if cn then
      request_handle:headers():add("X-Ssl-Client-Cn", cn)
    end
  end

  local authority = request_handle:headers():get(":authority")
  local host, port = string.match(authority, "([^:]+):?(%d*)")

  if port ~= nil and port ~= "" then
    request_handle:headers():add("X-Forwarded-Port", port)
  end
end
